trial-design and multi-trial portfolio verifiers, reviewer-approved endpoint mapping, explicit mapping-gated source-disjoint non-pooled clinical synthesis with shared ratio and percentage-point risk-difference semantics, a synthetic ulcerative-colitis cross-disease conformance slice, two payload-free public-source UC induction provider runs, one payload-free shared-NCT induction/maintenance population-alignment run, one independent primary-maintenance risk-difference replication with screened controls, one public-source rheumatoid-arthritis ACR20 risk-difference HOLD replication, one source-disjoint non-pooled olokizumab additive tensor, and one fail-closed olokizumab population-stratified transport diagnostic, provenance-preserving clinical evidence tensor compilation with scale-specific precision and bounded VOI action planning, accepted-state-bindable cohort diagnostics with matched policy sensitivity and provenance-overlap reporting, preregistered package-bound clinical forecasts with aggregate calibration, paired policy evaluation, dependence-audited CR1 uncertainty, aggregate synthetic prospective clustered-board design simulation, informative-evaluability/residual-dependence stress analysis, preregistered prediction-stratified pattern-mixture sensitivity analysis, dependence-closed cluster-jackknife sampling calibration, unequal-cluster influence calibration, informative-cluster-size dual-estimand calibration, and empirical-template cluster-superpopulation calibration, bounded selected-action execution with compact receipts, reviewer-only refresh and source-rejoined before/after transition validation, adapters and bindings, typed promotion and identity ledgers, execution core, tests, documentation, schemas, audit code, and the ctdbench scorer. The provider runs validate contract behavior only; the shared-NCT phase analyses count as one trial, the independent UC maintenance run uses a different candidate, the single-trial RA replication is separate from the non-pooled olokizumab tensor, and the population diagnostic does not estimate transport. None supports participant identity, exchangeability, pooling, efficacy, safety acceptability, external transportability, or an end-to-end therapeutic claim.
